offers.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.3" 60Hz Laptop - Intel Core 5 320 - 8GB DDR5 RAM - 512GB SSD - Windows 11 Home - Luna Grey

reviews.quote: Targets budget-oriented laptops, but the performance results are nothing too exciting; a solid all-round cheap everyday machine.
A dependable machine for $799 with a bright screen and solid performance for everyday use.
Pedestrian performance and budget-grade construction; at $1,299 we simply can't justify it.

praises: Backlit keyboard at this price is unusual and appreciated in dorms and night use
1080p IR webcam with privacy shutter is well above the budget-class norm
USB-C charges the laptop from a phone brick, so the 65W charger is easy to replace
Light for a 15-inch all-plastic chassis at 1.63 kg; easy to carry in a backpack
SSD boot is quick and wake-from-sleep is instant for the class
complaints: 45% NTSC IPS panel looks washed out; colours shift when off-axis despite being IPS
Keyboard deck and lid flex noticeably when typing or carrying
Only 8GB RAM and soldered LPDDR5 on many of these boards — no upgrade path
HDMI 1.4 caps external monitors at 4K30, annoying for dock setups
Lenovo Vantage bloatware and pop-up promos on a fresh setup

standouts: BF sale price of $599.99 makes this the cheapest current-platform 15.3" WUXGA IPS option at BBY
1080p IR webcam + privacy shutter + backlit keyboard is a webcam/call-spec unusually good for budget
design_philosophy: Lenovo's IdeaPad Slim 3 line is the volume budget chassis: thin-and-light styling in all-plastic shells, current-generation mainstream CPUs, and cost taken out of panel colour gamut, chassis rigidity, and battery capacity. This Core 5 320 config is the sweet-spot SKU of the line — the larger 47Wh battery and 512GB SSD over the 256GB twin, at a price that collapses to exceptional on sale.
rating_notes: No pro review score found (see SHARED-ideapad-slim3.md; PCMag/NBC/Tom's bot-walled or absent) — ratings are platform-anchored from verified specs, not inferred from a reviewed sibling, hence inferred:true on all family entries. Panel is IPS but 45% NTSC (~62-68% sRGB), ~300 nits assumed at class norm. Brightness/nits and battery hours are class estimates; battery capacity 5306 mAh verified. RAM soldering varies within the line — flagged as likely soldered.
